QUIC test helpers for boot, anonymous setup, virtual pairs, UDP sockets, and netem.

# Purpose
This file provides QUIC test support code. It defines default callback functions for QUIC connection and stream events, and it adds optional TLS key log capture to a `pcapng` file through `fd_quic_test_pcap`. It also contains test runtime control functions, [`fd_quic_test_boot`](<#fd_quic_test_boot>) and [`fd_quic_test_halt`](<#fd_quic_test_halt>), which open and close the packet capture file when the `--pcap` command line option is used.

The file also contains helper functions to create and configure test `fd_quic_t` objects, including [`fd_quic_config_anonymous`](<#fd_quic_config_anonymous>), [`fd_quic_config_test_signer`](<#fd_quic_config_test_signer>), [`fd_quic_new_anonymous`](<#fd_quic_new_anonymous>), and [`fd_quic_new_anonymous_small`](<#fd_quic_new_anonymous_small>). It provides virtual pair setup for two QUIC endpoints, with direct packet delivery or packet capture through `pcapng`, and it includes UDP socket helpers for test use. At the end, it defines a simple network emulation layer in [`fd_quic_netem_init`](<#fd_quic_netem_init>) and [`fd_quic_netem_send`](<#fd_quic_netem_send>) that can drop or reorder packets before passing them to the next `fd_aio` target.
